intro: In Stormwind City's Old Town, the Pig and Whistle Tavern welcomes travelers and local laborers. Veterans gather there to remember the kingdom's past conflicts.

p: In Old Town's winding alleys, the Pig and Whistle Tavern offers warmth, ale, and lodging. Common citizens, working folk, and travelers fresh from the road gather there. Merchants such as recipe vendor Kendor Kabonka share the room with grizzled veterans, who trade memories of the First and Second Wars over their tankards.
